title: As U.S.-Canada trade talks collapse, Carney says retaliatory tariffs will start Sept. 8
summary_full: New 50% Trump administration tariffs on some Canadian exports went into place after the U.S. and Canada failed to reach a deal on Friday.
summary_public: New 50% Trump administration tariffs on some Canadian exports went into place after the U.S. and Canada failed to reach a deal on Friday.
